status: Completed native fixed-M internal-field diagnostic; not a demagnetization/lifetime qualification
method: Native bound-surface-current diagnostics plus analytical solid-angle point checks and component bounds for rectangular bars.
limits: Fixed uniform magnetization; no material recoil curve, local demagnetization feedback, hot-property update or actual grade certificate.
Near-surface source quadrature and smoothing can bias fields; sampled maxima are not worst-case bounds, especially sharp corners and seams.
Applied-current self-field and external return conductors are absent. Do not compare only to room-temperature Hcj or call centre margin a full lifetime qualification.

Use a supplier-certified grade and hot curve; a generic300C maximum does not establish recoil/irreversible-loss margin. Analytical component bound does not bound transverse H or current-induced heating.
reason: At the native positive-H extremum, closed form gives -130kA/m while native q4 gives+282kA/m. At the negative extremum it gives-302 versus-461. Near-centre error is0.23kA/m. This near-face quadrature error precludes a lifetime conclusion from sampled extrema.
bound_derivation: Inside a uniformly magnetized cuboid, both charged end faces oppose M. Each face subtends at most2pi steradians; at least one face is>=5mm away, so that face subtends no more than the centred25x5mm rectangle at5mm. Sum/(4pi) bounds the opposing H component. The aligned opposite pole supports M within the common rectangular projection; ignoring that support retains the bound. Fixed-M, mu_r1 and ideal abutting bars only; current self-field absent.

grade_curve_reference.scope: Visually inspected typical YXG26H curves; the250C curve has not entered its steep polarization fall by about-0.5MA/m. This is not a batch certificate for the catalogue bars or a quantitative knee measurement.

individual_bar_bound_scope: Neglect supporting field from all other aligned bars. Applies to each actual5mm-thick stock bar, even with small seam gaps; the481kA/m bound uses an ideal continuous10mm pair. FixedM,mu_r1 only; current and transverse fields/recoil excluded.
